set.description: Bullfrog's 1998 real-time strategy game lets you command a tribe, reshape the land and lead a shaman toward divinity. The DRM-free Windows GOG release includes Undiscovered Worlds, while community-run online matches use the separate Populous Reincarnated Matchmaker edition.

set.launcherInstall.note: Paid DRM-free GOG game with the Undiscovered Worlds expansion. Buy and install the Windows offline package, then use PlayBound Locate. The community Matchmaker is a separate edition and requires a popre.net account for online matches.

qualityBar.verdict: A strange, lively RTS where every hill can become a weapon and the shaman is the most dangerous unit on the map.

set.longDescription:
Populous: The Beginning starts before you are a god. You lead a tribe through a series of planets, building settlements, training followers and letting your shaman learn how to change the battlefield. A stretch of water can separate two armies until a spell raises land beneath their feet. A comfortable village can become a bad place to stand when the other tribe's shaman arrives. Bullfrog turned the familiar strategy-game contest for resources into something with moving ground under it.

The single-player route runs across 25 planets, each asking you to take another step toward divinity. Your people need buildings, jobs and protection, but you cannot win by staring only at a production menu. The shaman walks into danger alongside them, and her spells can change the terrain and the rhythm of a fight. It is the contrast that makes the game memorable: you may spend several minutes planning a safe expansion, then watch the geography itself refuse to cooperate. The GOG package includes the Undiscovered Worlds expansion, giving owners more places to test what they have learned.

There is multiplayer, though the route needs to be described accurately. GOG lists a multiplayer feature, and the Populous Reincarnated community operates a Matchmaker that connects players to online games. That community client needs a game installation or its own multiplayer essentials, plus a popre.net account; it is represented separately as the Matchmaker edition in PlayBound. The base GOG game's ownership and install record should not imply that clicking a PlayBound party button automatically joins a Matchmaker room. Local or virtual-LAN play should be offered only after the exact executable, patch level and connection path have been tested. There is no verified dedicated server for this catalog record and no documented native controller mode.

This is a paid Windows game. GOG's DRM-free offline installer can be downloaded after purchase without needing Galaxy to run. GOG has also maintained its preservation build, with Windows 10 and 11 compatibility checks and an updated graphics wrapper. Its current listed minimum is Windows 10, a 1.8 GHz CPU, 2 GB RAM, DirectX 9.0c-class graphics and 2 GB of storage. Those figures belong to the current GOG package, not the much smaller original disc requirements that had been sitting in the Draft. The old record also incorrectly said no purchase was required; that would send players looking for free files they are not entitled to redistribute.

Populous: The Beginning earns its place with a specific kind of chaos. You have a tribe to care for and a map to read, but the map is never truly fixed. When a spell turns an enemy's safe approach into your own crossing, it feels like strategy and mischief happened at the same moment.
set.whyWePickedIt: Populous: The Beginning makes terrain as important as troops, and its shaman turns ordinary RTS planning into spectacular improvisation. The preserved GOG version includes Undiscovered Worlds, while the active Reincarnated community gives owners a path toward online matches. We keep the paid base game and community Matchmaker edition clearly separate.
set.thatOneThing: The enemy has a defensible coastline right up until your shaman decides that coastline is a suggestion.

installSteps.text: Purchase Populous: The Beginning on GOG. Download its Windows DRM-free offline installer, which includes Undiscovered Worlds; Galaxy is optional.
Run the GOG installer. Use PlayBound Locate to select the installed Populous folder; PlayBound does not distribute the paid base-game files.
Start the base game for its campaign. For community online play, select the separate Populous Reincarnated Matchmaker edition after the base install is found.

firstPlaySteps.text: Begin the campaign and learn how huts grow your tribe, how followers train, and how your shaman's first terrain spell changes an approach route.

multiplayerGamingSteps.text: Install and open the separate Populous Reincarnated Matchmaker edition and register a popre.net account.
Point Matchmaker at your owned Populous installation, then host or join a room in its own lobby. A PlayBound party does not yet automatically enter that lobby.

faq.a: No. The current GOG version is a paid DRM-free purchase. The community Matchmaker is separate software, not a free license to the base game.
Yes. GOG says its package includes the base game and Undiscovered Worlds expansion.

faq.q: Can I play online with friends?
faq.a: The Reincarnated community Matchmaker supports online games for owners who install it and create a popre.net account. PlayBound automatic party joining has not yet been verified.
No native controller support or tested PlayBound Controls profile is verified for this mouse-driven strategy game.
GOG lists Windows and reports compatibility testing for Windows 10 and 11.
